```sql
BEGIN;
SET LOCAL lock_timeout = '100ms';
SET LOCAL statement_timeout = '1s';

LOCK TABLE public.users IN ACCESS EXCLUSIVE MODE NOWAIT;

ALTER TABLE public.users ADD COLUMN preferred_name text;

CREATE FUNCTION public.sync_user_names()
RETURNS trigger
LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $$
BEGIN
  IF TG_OP = 'INSERT' THEN
    IF NEW.display_name IS NOT NULL
       AND NEW.preferred_name IS NOT NULL
       AND NEW.display_name IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.preferred_name THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'name fields disagree' USING ERRCODE = '23514';
    END IF;

    NEW.display_name := COALESCE(NEW.display_name, NEW.preferred_name);
    NEW.preferred_name := COALESCE(NEW.preferred_name, NEW.display_name);
  ELSE
    IF NEW.display_name IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.display_name
       AND NEW.preferred_name IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.preferred_name THEN
      IF NEW.display_name IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.preferred_name THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'name fields disagree' USING ERRCODE = '23514';
      END IF;
    ELSIF NEW.display_name IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.display_name THEN
      NEW.preferred_name := NEW.display_name;
    ELSIF NEW.preferred_name IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.preferred_name THEN
      NEW.display_name := NEW.preferred_name;
    ELSIF NEW.preferred_name IS NULL THEN
      NEW.preferred_name := NEW.display_name;
    END IF;
  END IF;

  IF NEW.display_name IS NULL OR NEW.preferred_name IS NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'name is required' USING ERRCODE = '23502';
  END IF;

  IF NEW.display_name IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.preferred_name THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'name fields disagree' USING ERRCODE = '23514';
  END IF;

  RETURN NEW;
END;
$$;

CREATE TRIGGER users_sync_names
BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE ON public.users
FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION public.sync_user_names();

ALTER TABLE public.users
  ADD CONSTRAINT users_preferred_name_present
    CHECK (preferred_name IS NOT NULL) NOT VALID,
  ADD CONSTRAINT users_names_equal
    CHECK (display_name = preferred_name) NOT VALID;

COMMIT;
```

```sql
SET LOCAL lock_timeout = '100ms';
SET LOCAL statement_timeout = '1s';

SELECT job FROM public.name_backfill_progress
WHERE job = 'preferred_name'
FOR UPDATE;

WITH batch AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT u.id
  FROM public.users u
  CROSS JOIN public.name_backfill_progress p
  WHERE p.job = 'preferred_name'
    AND NOT p.finished
    AND (p.last_id IS NULL OR u.id > p.last_id)
    AND u.id <= p.high_id

  SET preferred_name = u.display_name
  FROM batch b
  WHERE u.id = b.id AND u.preferred_name IS NULL
  RETURNING u.id

UPDATE public.name_backfill_progress
SET last_id = COALESCE((SELECT max(id) FROM batch), last_id),
    finished = NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM batch)
WHERE job = 'preferred_name'

COMMIT;
```

```sql
      NEW.display_name IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.display_name;
    new_changed :=
      NEW.preferred_name IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.preferred_name;

    IF old_changed AND new_changed THEN
      IF NEW.display_name IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.preferred_name THEN

END;
```
